description: Enforces the PID v3.1 Access Method Decision Table. Triggers on each new 'Access Requests' item and routes by user type: rejects service/shared accounts outright, redirects view-only staff to the Employee App and screens to display pages, checks M365 (SharePoint) and Entra ID P2 licences via Graph before any approval, makes contractor guest access time-bound with owner + InfoSec approval, and sends privileged admin requests to InfoSec for a PIM eligible assignment. Approved access is granted only through security groups.

parameters.item/DecisionLog: Service, shared and generic accounts are explicitly prohibited from SharePoint access (PID v3.1, Access Method Decision Table).

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: SharePoint access request rejected: shared accounts are prohibited
parameters.emailMessage/Body: Service, shared and generic accounts are not permitted to access SharePoint Online. Each person must use their own named account.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Use the Employee App to view this content
parameters.emailMessage/Body: View-only access to departmental content, policies and H&S information is provided through the Employee App, which needs no SharePoint licence. If you need to edit or collaborate, submit a new request choosing Employee - edit / collaborate.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Screens and kiosks use published display pages
parameters.emailMessage/Body: Screens and kiosks show published pages in display mode with no sign-in or input. The site owner can publish the notice page; no account will be created.

parameters.WebhookApprovalCreationInput/details: @{concat('Requester: ', triggerBody()?['Requester']?['Email'], decodeUriComponent('%0A'), 'Access type: ', triggerBody()?['UserType']?['Value'], decodeUriComponent('%0A'), 'Site: ', body('Get_target_site')?['SiteUrl'], decodeUriComponent('%0A'), 'Justification: ', triggerBody()?['BusinessJustification'])}

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Approved SharePoint access request #@{triggerBody()?['ID']}.

Add @{triggerBody()?['Requester']?['Email']} to on-premises AD group @{body('Edit_Get_group')?['displayName']} (Member (read/write) on @{body('Get_target_site')?['SiteTitle']}). The group is synchronised from AD, so it cannot be changed from the cloud.

You now have Member (read/write) access to @{body('Get_target_site')?['SiteTitle']}: @{body('Get_target_site')?['SiteUrl']}

It can take up to an hour to apply.

Your request for access to @{body('Get_target_site')?['SiteTitle']} was rejected.

Comments: @{join(xpath(xml(json(concat('{"root":{"r":', string(outputs('Edit_Approval_site_owner')?['body/responses']), '}}'))), '//comments/text()'), ' | ')}

parameters.item/DecisionLog: Editing SharePoint Online content requires a named Microsoft 365 licence that includes SharePoint (minimum M365 F3). No such licence is assigned to your account.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: SharePoint access request blocked: licence required
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Editing SharePoint Online content requires a named Microsoft 365 licence that includes SharePoint (minimum M365 F3). No such licence is assigned to your account.

Your line manager can raise a licence request with the Service Desk; resubmit once it is assigned.

Add @{triggerBody()?['Requester']?['Email']} to on-premises AD group @{body('Owner_Get_group')?['displayName']} (Site Owner / Author on @{body('Get_target_site')?['SiteTitle']}). The group is synchronised from AD, so it cannot be changed from the cloud.

You now have Site Owner / Author access to @{body('Get_target_site')?['SiteTitle']}: @{body('Get_target_site')?['SiteUrl']}

It can take up to an hour to apply.

Your request for access to @{body('Get_target_site')?['SiteTitle']} was rejected.

parameters.item/DecisionLog: Site Owners / Authors require Entra ID P2 per the Access Method Decision Table.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Site Owner access blocked: Entra ID P2 required
parameters.emailMessage/Body: The approved access model requires Site Owners and Authors to hold Entra ID P2 for ownership accountability and audit. Ask the Service Desk to assign it, then resubmit.

parameters.item/DecisionLog: Site Owner / Author access requires a named Microsoft 365 E3 (or equivalent) licence that includes SharePoint.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: SharePoint access request blocked: licence required
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Site Owner / Author access requires a named Microsoft 365 E3 (or equivalent) licence that includes SharePoint.

Your line manager can raise a licence request with the Service Desk; resubmit once it is assigned.

parameters.item/DecisionLog: Guest access must have an end date no more than 12 months away.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Guest access request rejected: end date required
parameters.emailMessage/Body: Contractor (guest) access must be time-bound. Resubmit with an access end date no more than 12 months from today.
